description: Authority policy for validator certification. Defines what each authority level can and cannot certify.

authority_rules.description: Generated but untested. May not be used for any certification decision.
Passes visible fixtures. Can certify individual artifact existence but not overall run completion.
Passes independent/adversarial fixtures and mutation tests. Can serve as a certifying verifier.
Human or external benchmark verifier. Maximum authority for non-core validators.
Handwritten core harness validator. Maximum authority. May certify other validators.

certification_chain_rule: A validator generated by Mercury may never certify itself. Certification must come from the core or from an already-certified V2+ validator.
